brief:
FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — HOOK. Copy v01_hook.html closely (background, hero speaker card, kinetic type).
Spoken: 'Is it possible to reverse engineer all the apps that you use every single day?'
TEXT HOOK (user-written, the ONE allowed exception to words.txt) — 'Software is cooked and finished' — must be FULLY READABLE ON FRAME 0 (this frame is the thumbnail) and stay on screen for the whole scene. Place it at the top of the safe zone (y ~290–520): 'Software is' Newsreader 600 ~110 px ink, 'cooked' Fraunces 700 italic accent ~200 px, 'and finished' Newsreader ~110 px (exact user copy: 'Software is cooked and finished'); collage-staggered across 2–3 lines, not centred block. Frame 0 = already landed (no entrance); give it continuous life: 1 % slow punch, a hand-drawn ocean underline under 'cooked' that is already drawn on frame 0, tiny float.
SPEAKER (0–4.43): HERO speaker card (~868x600 or a bit smaller so it fits under the hook, e.g. ~820x560) in the middle (y ~560–1130), 3D settle — readable by frame 0 too (start already ~90 % settled, finish the settle by 0.3 s), face centred.
KINETIC (below the card, y ~1150–1470): 'reverse engineer' lands on 'reverse' (~1.08 s): 'reverse' Fraunces italic accent ~200, 'engineer' Fraunces italic ink ~170, offset; then 'all the apps' Newsreader ~96 on 'apps' (~2.3); on 'every single day?' (3.25–4.29) a stack of 4–5 small plain app tiles (rounded squares, --brand-card / --brand-deep, simple wireframe glyphs, NO logos) pops in a 3-frame stagger beside the text and then, on 'day' (~4.29), the top tile splits into 3 exploded layers (isometric offset) — the reverse-engineering idea. 'every single day?' Newsreader ~84 lands with the tiles. Keep the text hook visible the whole time. Hold alive to the cut.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — CHAPTER + REAL PAGE. Copy v04_taste.html for the browser card/stat pill and v02_skills.html for the agent puck + dotted path.
Spoken: 'There's a new open-source repo called Reverse Engineer Anything that lets Codex or Claude Code or any coding agent that you use' (exact times in words.txt).
BEAT A (0–3.4): small Geist label 'open-source repo' (muted) appears on 'open-source' (~0.7); title 'Reverse Engineer Anything' as a big collage: 'Reverse' Fraunces italic accent ~210 lands on 'Reverse' (~2.06), 'Engineer' Newsreader ~150 (~2.48), 'Anything.' Fraunces italic ink ~210 (~3.0), top of zone. Behind/below it the REAL repo page hf/assets/rea_repo.png in a large tilted browser card (URL 'github.com/morluto/rea'), slow internal scroll from top (repo header, '100.8k stars' visible); black stat pill '★ 100.8k on GitHub' pops beside it on 'repo' (~1.26). Secondary/small speaker card (hf/assets/speaker.mp4) tucked at a lower corner overlapping the browser card from ~0.3 s, face centred.
BEAT B (3.5–6.9): title compacts upward / browser card shrinks back; on 'Codex' (~3.92), 'Claude Code' (~4.44) and 'any coding agent' (~5.24–5.9) three black text pills pop in (plain Geist text, NO logos) and kinetic words land: 'Codex' and 'Claude Code' Fraunces italic ~120–150 (one accent), 'any coding agent' Newsreader ~96. On 'agent' (~5.9) the black agent puck (robot face, accent eye dots) drops in centre-low and the three pills ride dotted paths into it; puck glows/bobs on 'use' (~6.6). Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — EXPLAINER (graphics-led, small speaker card). Copy object styling from v02_skills.html / v06_layers.html.
Spoken: 'take a look inside an app that it has no source code or no information about figure out how every single feature works'.
BEAT A (0–3.3): a big sealed deep-teal APP CARD (--brand-deep, radius 28, ~640x780, wireframe UI glyphs in accent/grey, a small padlock badge) rises centre; the agent puck from the previous scene sits beside it. Kinetic: 'take a look' Newsreader ~96, 'inside' Fraunces italic accent ~210 lands on 'inside' (~0.57) — the puck slides INTO the card on a dotted path on 'inside'. On 'no source code' (~1.97–2.65): 'no source code' Newsreader ~110 with an ocean strike-through drawn on 'code' (~2.65); 'no information' (~3.25–3.75) smaller ~84, also struck.
BEAT B (3.4–7.13): on 'figure out' (~4.49) an accent scan line sweeps the card, and the card SPLITS into 3 stacked isometric slabs (like v06 layers) labelled with REA's REAL step names, landing in sequence: '01 Decode branches' (~4.6), '02 Trace calls' (~5.1), '03 Recover the rule' (~5.6) — Geist labels on the slabs. Then on 'every single feature works' (5.71–6.95) 3–4 small white feature rows ('feature' wireframe bar + accent ✓ drawn SVG) tick in a stagger beside/below; kinetic 'every single' Newsreader ~90 + 'feature' Fraunces italic ink ~200 + 'works.' Fraunces italic accent ~200 lands on 'works' (~6.95, punch). Small speaker card (~330x230) top-right corner the whole scene, face centred. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — MECHANISM — evidence → build.
Spoken: 'show you the evidence for it and then build you a version of that same software'.
BEAT A (0–2.0): the 3 REA slabs from the previous scene collapse into one white EVIDENCE card (--brand-card) that slides up: a mono pseudo-code snippet (Geist mono, illustrative, generic e.g. 'func search(query) → index.match(…)' 4–5 lines, grey bars ok) with 2–3 accent pins and black note pills 'string ref', 'call trace', 'branch' (illustrative labels only). Kinetic: 'show you the' Newsreader ~96, 'evidence' Fraunces italic accent ~230 lands on 'evidence' (~0.93), with a dotted ellipse drawing around it.
BEAT B (2.0–3.97): on 'build' (~2.13) a new deep-teal app card builds BLOCK BY BLOCK (header bar, hero block, 3 tiles, button — 3-frame stagger) beside/below the evidence card, a dotted path linking them; label pill '→ your version' black. Kinetic: 'build you a' Newsreader ~96, 'version' Fraunces italic ink ~210 lands ~2.67, 'of that same software' Newsreader ~84 (~3.2–3.7). Secondary speaker card (~560x390) may peek in from a corner in beat B (face centred) — optional if space; keep the lower zone filled. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — B-ROLL COLLAGE — real clips of things people made (from a credited YouTube video). The three clips are in hf/assets/: game_minecraft.mp4 (1760x984, 1.85 s), game_sim.mp4 (1312x980, 1.35 s), game_fps.mp4 (548x976 vertical, 1.85 s). They are short: loop each (muted, framework-owned video; if looping is awkward, hold the last frame — no black frames ever). Keep their TikTok handle watermarks visible/uncropped where possible (they get credited).
Spoken: 'people are using it for making games desktop applications mobile applications and literally every single piece of software that they can make with it'.
BEAT A (0–3.4) GAMES: on 'games' (~2.07) a large tilted DESKTOP WINDOW card (light chrome bar, 3 dots) deals in playing game_minecraft.mp4, then a second smaller window with game_sim.mp4 overlaps it (~2.4); kinetic before that: 'people are using it' Newsreader ~90 (0.06–0.5), 'making' Newsreader ~110 (~1.12), 'games' Fraunces italic accent ~240 lands on 'games' (~2.07, punch).
BEAT B (2.4–5.3): 'desktop' (~2.41) Fraunces italic ink ~170 beside the windows; on 'mobile' (~3.85) a PHONE card (rounded 52 px, dark bezel) rises playing game_fps.mp4 (it is vertical — fits the phone), 'mobile' Fraunces italic accent ~170; 'applications' Newsreader ~84 under each.
BEAT C (5.4–8.5): on 'literally every single piece of software' (5.45–7.2) the windows + phone shrink into a fan and MANY small app cards (8–12 plain wireframe UI cards / app tiles, no logos) deal out around them in a 2-frame stagger, filling the frame; kinetic 'every single piece of' Newsreader ~90 + 'software' Fraunces italic ink ~220 lands ~7.19, 'they can make with it.' small ~70. Hold alive. No speaker card in this scene.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — REAL PAGE + ACTION. Copy browser-card + stat-pill styling from v04_taste.html.
Spoken: 'it's growing crazy on GitHub and you can try to just type in this command'.
BEAT A (0–2.4): the REAL GitHub Trending page hf/assets/gh_trending.png in a big tilted browser card (URL 'github.com/trending'), scrolled so the first repo row 'morluto / rea' (it's the #1 row, ~y 680–830 in the 1080-wide PNG at 2x, i.e. CSS y 340–415) is visible; an accent highlight ring/box draws around that row on 'growing' (~0.47); black stat pill '★ 25,585 stars today' and a small '#1 Trending' pill pop beside it on 'crazy' (~1.13). Kinetic: 'growing' Newsreader ~120, 'crazy' Fraunces italic accent ~240 lands on 'crazy' (~1.13, punch), 'on GitHub' Newsreader ~110 (~1.71).
BEAT B (2.4–4.25): browser card slides back/shrinks; a secondary speaker card (~560x390, face centred) enters; a black TERMINAL pill/card (Geist mono, white) types out '$ npx rea-agents@latest setup' character by character between 'try' (~2.51) and 'command' (~3.87), blinking accent cursor, then a white cursor arrow clicks a 'Copy' chip with a tiny 'Copied ✓' flash. (The command is real — from rea.tools, hf/assets/rea_site.png shows it.) Kinetic: 'just type in' Newsreader ~96, 'this command' Fraunces italic ink ~180 lands on 'command' (~3.87). Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — LIST DEAL — seven apps. Copy coins from v01_hook.html and browser card from v04_taste.html.
Spoken: 'last week someone else also used AI to rebuild seven applications of Adobe and make them all open source'.
BEAT A (0–2.8): 'last week' Newsreader ~96 (0.05–0.27), 'someone else' Fraunces italic ink ~160 (~0.57), 'used AI' Newsreader ~110 (~1.81), 'to rebuild' Newsreader ~96 (~2.49). The REAL repo page hf/assets/photocraft_repo.png (storytold/photocraft — header shows '47.2k stars', README says 'clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop') in a tilted browser card (URL 'github.com/storytold/photocraft'), slow scroll, from ~0.5 s.
BEAT B (2.8–5.55): on 'seven' (~2.93) the page shrinks to the upper area and 'seven' Fraunces italic accent ~260 lands huge (punch); coins 01–07 roll in (2-frame stagger) and each deals a white chip/card with the REAL app name in Geist 600: PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, FilmCraft, LightCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft, DesignCraft (slugs storytold/<lowercase>, muted). Grid them neatly 2 columns or a fan — all 7 legible (chip text ≥ 40 px). 'applications of Adobe' Newsreader ~96 on 'Adobe' (~3.89) — plain text, no logo. On 'open source' (5.17–5.43) every chip flips/ticks with an accent ✓ (drawn SVG) in a fast stagger and a black pill 'all open source' stamps over the stack; 'open source.' Fraunces italic ink ~170. No speaker card. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — SPEAKER + VERDICT. Copy hero card from v01_hook.html, strike-through from v09_taste.html.
Spoken: 'now are they perfect no but do they work definitely yes which actually makes me wonder'.
HERO speaker card (~868x600, face centred) top (y ~300–900), lands fast (readable by 0.25 s).
KINETIC below (y ~950–1470): 'are they' Newsreader ~96 + 'perfect?' Fraunces italic ink ~220 lands on 'perfect' (~0.69); on 'no' (~0.91) an ocean strike-through draws across 'perfect?' and a small black pill '✗ no' pops (drawn SVG ✗). On 'work' (~1.57) the stack slides up/compacts: 'do they' Newsreader ~96 + 'work?' Fraunces italic accent ~240 lands; on 'yes' (~2.45) a big accent ✓ (drawn SVG) draws beside it and a black pill '✓ definitely yes' pops; 1 % punch. 'makes me wonder' Newsreader ~84 fades in on 'wonder' (~3.55) with a tiny dotted '?' loop. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — THESIS. Hero type scene with one object.
Spoken: 'is software really dead and also that software is going to get really hard to protect'.
BEAT A (0–2.4): 'is' Newsreader ~110, 'software' Newsreader 600 ~210 (~0.55), 'really' Newsreader ~110 (~0.99), 'dead?' Fraunces italic accent ~260 lands on 'dead' (~1.35) with a punch and a dotted ellipse drawing around it. Big, filling the zone, staggered collage.
BEAT B (2.4–5.25): text compacts to the top; a deep-teal APP CARD (same as v03) centre with a big soft white SHIELD + PADLOCK object (no outlines, soft shadow) closing over it on 'software' (~2.65); kinetic 'really hard to' Newsreader ~96 (~4.1–4.5) and 'protect' Fraunces italic ink ~220 lands ~4.85; at ~4.9 the shield CRACKS (2–3 pieces separate with a little rotation) and the padlock pops open — accent glint. Small speaker card (~330x230, face centred) at a corner during beat B. Hold alive into the cut.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — MECHANISM — copy in minutes.
Spoken: 'because if an AI agent can look at your app can look at your software can look at all the features and build someone else a version of it in the matter of a couple of minutes'.
BEAT A (0–5.2): left-centre a deep-teal 'your app' card (Geist label pill 'your app'); the black agent puck enters on 'AI agent' (~0.68–1.1). Three LOOKS, one per spoken 'look at…': the puck's eyes/scan beam (accent, soft cone or dotted lines) sweeps the card on 'app' (~2.2), 'software' (~3.28), 'all the features' (~4.65) — each look highlights a different layer: whole card → its code layer (mono bars) → its feature rows (✓). Kinetic per look, replacing each other quickly at top: 'can look at your' Newsreader ~84 + 'app' Fraunces italic accent ~220; then 'software' Fraunces italic ink ~200; then 'all the features' Fraunces italic accent ~170.
BEAT B (5.2–8.47): on 'build' (~5.27) a COPY of the card peels off (lighter, slightly translucent then solidifies) and slides along a dotted path to the right to a small black pill 'someone else' (~5.61–5.85); kinetic 'build someone else a' Newsreader ~84, 'version' Fraunces italic ink ~200 (~6.31). On 'a couple of minutes' (7.67–8.31) a round timer ring (accent arc) sweeps quickly and 'minutes.' Fraunces italic accent ~240 lands on 'minutes' (~8.31) with punch. Secondary speaker card (~560x390, face centred) present in beat B upper area if it fits — otherwise small card. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — WRAP-UP. Copy hero card from v01_hook.html and strike/struck word from v09_taste.html.
Spoken: 'our features are not what's going to keep you ahead of everyone else I think what's left of software is personal built for literally how you work with these softwares every single day'. NEVER show the word 'softwares'.
BEAT A (0–3.7): HERO speaker card (~868x600, face centred) top; kinetic below: 'our' Newsreader ~96 + 'features' Fraunces italic ink ~230 lands on 'features' (~0.54); on 'not' (~1.3) an ocean strike-through draws across 'features'; 'keep you' Newsreader ~96 + 'ahead' Fraunces italic accent ~200 lands ~2.64, with a small up-arrow chip; 'of everyone else' ~70.
BEAT B (3.8–10.23): card shrinks to secondary size (~560x390) and moves up/left; 'what's left of' Newsreader ~96 (~4.4), 'software is' Newsreader ~110 (~5.16), 'personal' Fraunces italic accent ~260 lands HUGE on 'personal' (~6.28) with a punch and an underline drawing. Then on 'built for literally how you work' (6.54–8.18) a set of 4–5 soft UI cards/tiles assembles AROUND the speaker card like a custom-fit layout (snapping into a frame shaped to it) — the 'built for how you work' idea; kinetic 'built for' Newsreader ~84, 'how you work' Fraunces italic ink ~170 lands on 'work' (~8.18). On 'every single day' (9.45–10.05) a tiny black pill row of day chips 'Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri' ticks accent in a stagger, 'every single day.' Newsreader ~84. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md (fully, incl. Project specifics) and look at the style frames it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — CTA. Copy v10_cta.html closely (Comment + giant quoted word + dotted loop + speaker card + inbox pill + alive end hold).
Spoken: 'if you also want to try REA or reverse engineer anything out just comment reverse and I'll send you the link to the repository straight to your inbox. Just be a little careful of what you do.' Scene is 9.72 s; speech ends ~8.1 s, the rest is the freeze-frame end hold (speaker.mp4 is padded with a freeze) — keep it ALIVE.
BEAT A (0–3.2): 'want to try' Newsreader ~96 + 'REA' Fraunces italic accent ~230 lands on 'REA' (~1.26); 'reverse engineer anything' Newsreader ~84 (~1.94–2.68). Small agent puck bobbing next to REA.
BEAT B (3.2–6.6): replace with 'Comment' Newsreader ~150 (~3.36) and '“reverse”' Fraunces italic accent ~240 in curly quotes lands on 'reverse' (~3.70) with punch; dotted loop path draws down to a tilted secondary/hero speaker card (face centred); on 'link to the repository' (~4.74–5.48) a white link chip 'github.com/morluto/rea' pops near the card and slides into a black pill '→ your inbox' that lands on 'inbox' (~6.46); 'straight to your' Newsreader ~84 + 'inbox' Fraunces italic accent ~200.
BEAT C (6.6–9.72): 'Just be a little' Newsreader ~96 (~6.62–7.0) + 'careful' Fraunces italic ink ~230 lands on 'careful' (~7.28), with a small black caution pill (drawn SVG ⚠ triangle, accent) beside it; 'of what you do.' Newsreader ~84 (~7.9). Keep 'Comment “reverse”' visible (compacted) at top through the end hold so the CTA is on the final frame. End hold alive: float, grid drift, pill pulse.
